protocol: byte-identical to E228 e226_auc2W: task-wise z-score with all-20-identity fit-row mean/std -> sqrt(w_b) block weights (E227 auc2_lofo mean) -> subtract pooled fit mean pm, multiply PCA W (1569x96) -> k=12 k-means prototypes per (task, identity). Read from the frozen E227 deploy model; nothing is refitted.

frozen_calibration.tau_rule: tau = (1-A) quantile of the deployment model inner 5-block OOF known scores (fit rows of all 20 identities, trial fraction <= 0.6)
frozen_calibration.note: tau is carried over from E228 unchanged; E233 never re-calibrates it. The LOSO path is not touched by any alignment, so the LOSO rejection is identical by construction and is re-verified from the frozen fold caches.

alignment.grouping: (session, task) on Test. Session enters only as a batch key for an unlabeled statistic; it never selects an identity and never gates a sample.
alignment.train_reference: per-task mean and covariance of the fit rows (all 20 identities, trial fraction <= 0.6) in the frozen PCA space. The task reference is used because scoring is task-wise; using the pooled global mean (which is ~0 by PCA centering) would delete the task offset and is reported separately as a diagnostic.
alignment.min_cell_n_note: Cells below this size would not be aligned; the smallest cell in Test is session1/EO with 291 rows, so no cell falls below the guard.

candidates.baseline_frozen: no alignment; exactly the E228 e226_auc2W Test read-out (reference row).
candidates.mean_align: z <- z - mean(z | session, task) + mean_train(task). Removes the whole batch translation of every (session, task) cell, identically for S1 and S2.
candidates.coral: standard CORAL per (session, task): mean align + whiten with the shrunk batch covariance C_s = (1-lam) C_batch + lam C_train(task) then recolour to C_train(task): z <- mu_train + (z - mu_batch) M, M = C_s^{-1/2} C_train^{1/2}.
candidates.mean_align_per_task_cov: mean align plus a diagonal-only covariance rescale per task: z <- mu_train + (z - mu_batch) * sqrt(var_train / var_eff), var_eff = (1-lam) diag(C_batch) + lam diag(C_train). No rotation.
candidates.mean_align_session2_only: DEGENERATE CONTROL, diagnostic only, never a conclusion: mean_align applied to session2 cells only, session1 untouched. Quantifies how much S2 rises and S1 falls when only the registered segment is aligned.
candidates.mean_align_pooled_global: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: mean align with the literal pooled Train global mean (pm -> 0 in PCA space). Shows the artefact of deleting the task offset; not a conclusion.

alignment.symmetric_note: mean_align / coral / mean_align_per_task_cov are applied with one identical rule to both sessions; the number of cells (8) and the estimator are the same. No per-segment parameter is tuned.

deploy.note: the adapter statistics are estimated from the unlabeled scoring batch; do not use for submission without confirming the rules

limitations: Official Test C/RA/ASafeR are N/A: Test has no identity labels. The official gate used here is the session-level S1 rejection >= 0.95 proxy requested by the reviewer. Transductive: the alignment statistics are estimated from the unlabeled Test inputs of the same (session, task) batch that is being scored, which sits in a grey zone of the competition rules and requires user confirmation before any submission use. Test has been inspected repeatedly since E65, so every S2 number carries a repeated-inspection bias. E232 showed session and registration status are heavily confounded (S1 = 5 unregistered subjects, S2 = 20 registered users), so S1/S2 are not clean biometric metrics.
